notes.title: 2 Minutes of Yuha's Nightmares | Dream: Evacuation [Video]
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="dhbxW_oRXIQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The Evacuation dream-level is inspired by one of my recurring dreams: a massive catastrophe unfolds, the world is falling apart, and I’m forced to evacuate my home. But I keep forgetting something — and it’s always something important: scissors, my passport, a phone charger. And of course, I can’t leave without the HDD that holds the Yuha’s Nightmares project! I run back, try again, only to realize I’ve left something else behind. And on top of that, even finding the way out of the house is no simple task. In the video, it’s solved elegantly — but is it truly effective?[/p]

notes.title: Yuha's Nightmares — Announcement Trailer
notes.content: [p]The trailer shows new locations, gameplay mechanics, fragments of glitchy dreams and the Wireframe World, and lets you feel the melancholic wibe of Yuha’s Nightmares. You’ll also find out when the game launches![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="cx_NiCPe-G0;full"][/previewyoutube]
